paragraph: He quit smoking for the **sake** of his health. For your **sake**, I hope that that doesn't happen. I did so for the **sake** of my health.
english: cause, interest or account

paragraph: He's caught in a **loop** of self-blame. I listened to that song on **loop** all day yesterday. This cold has knocked me for a **loop**.
english: a length of thread, line or rope that is doubled over to make an opening

paragraph: He hopes to find **fame** as a poet. He won **fame** by the novel. **Fame** and success don't always walk hand in hand.
english: state of being famous
arabicDesc: مثال: إنه يأمل أن يجد الشهرة كشاعر

paragraph: My dog often lies on the **grass**. These animals feed on **grass**. The cows are eating **grass**.
english: ground cover plant
arabicDesc: مثال: عادة ما يستلقي كلبي على العشب.

paragraph: Do you think that man was a newspaper **photographer**? How would you like to be our wedding **photographer**? I know the **photographer** who took this picture.
english: one who takes photographs, typically as an occupation

paragraph: The teacher corrected the **composition** that I had prepared. There are few, if any, errors in your **composition**. Your **composition** is perfect except for a few mistakes.
english: the act of putting together

paragraph: What do you want to accomplish in your **lifetime**? Here everything is as it was during her **lifetime**. The impact of such acts can last a **lifetime**.
english: the time a person is alive

paragraph: What do you think of **organic** honey from China? Is eating **organic** food worth what it costs? They say that they only eat **organic** food.
english: pertaining to or derived from living organisms

paragraph: The bus door **folded** back shut. With great effort she managed to **fold** one more. It is time to return to the **fold**.
english: bend (thin material) over

paragraph: I feel **chilled** to the bone today. I will go home and **chill** with my family. What he said cast a **chill** on the gathering.
english: a feeling of cold; also to relax (informal)
arabicDesc: مثال: أشعر ببرد في عظامي اليوم.

paragraph: Happiness does not consist of how much you **possess**. I **possess** three kinds of video-game machines. These hot springs **possess** properties for healing wounds.
english: to have (something) as, or as if as, an owner

paragraph: The **Colonel** has babied her all her life. The **Colonel** said the situation is under control. He was promoted to **colonel** two years ago.
english: an honorary civilian title bestowed by some southern US states, most commonly Kentucky
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: زعيم، زعيم رتبة، كولونيل

paragraph: Don't you think you're being a little bit **dramatic**? Don't take that **dramatic** attitude all of a sudden. Don't be so **dramatic**, it's just a bit of rain!
english: sudden and very noticeable; relating to theater

paragraph: **Evolution** is not an opinion, it's a fact. We're the result of 4.5 billion years of **evolution**. There is much documented evidence to prove **evolution**.
english: a change of position
arabicDesc: مثال: إنّ التطوّر ليس رأيا و إنّما هو واقع.

paragraph: We haven't seen a lot tourists around here **lately**. I haven't been sleeping well **lately**. I've been having a lot of negative thoughts **lately**.
english: recently
arabicDesc: مثال: نحن لم نرى الكثير من السياح بالقرب من هنا مؤخراً.

paragraph: I was looking for the **remote**. They sailed to the **remote** bay of the island. The power plant supplies the **remote** district with electricity.
english: at a distance
arabicDesc: مثال: كنت أبحث عن جهاز التحّكم.

paragraph: My decision was based on a **dealer** recommendation. The **dealer** wants to sell a car. The winner received a new car from a local car **dealer**.
english: one who deals in goods, especially automobiles

paragraph: We have been visited by a nation-wide economic **boom**. The computer industry is enjoying a **boom**. The small car **boom** is ending.
english: a time of fast growth; a loud deep sound

paragraph: We all live in the same hall of **residence**. You'll have to establish **residence** here before you can vote. Let us know if you change your **residence**.
english: the place where one lives (resides)

paragraph: The artist released her works into the public **domain**. It's time for you to renew your **domain** name. Shorter **domain** names are usually easier to remember.
english: a geographic area owned or controlled by a single person or organization

paragraph: The **laboratory** has the most up-to-date equipment. I wish to work in the **laboratory** some day. A series of blasts reduced the **laboratory** to ruins.
english: a room, building or institution equipped for scientific research, experimentation or analysis

other.meaning: place where chemicals, drugs or microbes are prepared or manufactured

paragraph: He is making **spare** parts in a car factory. I enjoy reading in my **spare** time. They send us **spare** parts.
english: to show mercy, to have mercy on
arabicDesc: مثال: هو يصنع قطع غيار في مصنع للسيارات.

paragraph: He put forward a plan for improving office **efficiency**. What we gained in **efficiency**, we lost in soul. She carefully explored the **efficiency** of the company.
english: working well without wasting time or energy

paragraph: Children like to drink fruit **juice**. She made the **juice** by herself. Did you drink this orange **juice**?
english: liquid from a plant
arabicDesc: مثال: يحب الأطفالُ شرب عصير الفواكه.

paragraph: The **treaty** was signed on November 18, 1903. More than one hundred nations have approved the **treaty**. This is the rough draft of the peace **treaty**.
english: formal binding agreement concluded by subjects of international law

paragraph: Leave a **margin** on the paper when you write. We left a **margin** for error in our estimates. He succeeded in the exam by a narrow **margin**.
english: the edge of the paper, typically left blank when printing but sometimes used for annotations etc

paragraph: The result of the experiment was a blue **substance**. This **substance** is going from liquid to solid state. I have no intention of taking this **substance** tonight.
english: physical matter

paragraph: He came to her **funeral**. At **funerals** we don't tell jokes, and we don't laugh! Why are you wearing gold pants to a **funeral**?
english: a ceremony to honor and remember a deceased person, often distinguished from a memorial service by the presence of the body of the deceased

paragraph: Her library **comprises** 3500 and includes many first editions. My house is **comprised** of these four rooms. The committee is **comprised** of ten members.
english: to consist of
arabicDesc: مثال: مكتبتها تشمل ثلاثة الاف و خمسمئة و تتضمن عدة طبعات اولى

paragraph: The publication consists of a **summary** and six sections. Could you please make a **summary** of the main points? A **summary** of his speech was printed in the newspaper.
english: an abstract or a condensed presentation of the substance of a body of material

paragraph: **Patch** the call through to my office, will you? You should try to **patch** things up with him. He hoped to **patch** things up with her.
english: a small piece of anything used to repair damage or a breach

other.meaning: To mend by sewing on a piece or pieces of cloth, leather, or the like (verb)

paragraph: An **announcement** of his death appeared in the newspapers. I couldn't understand the **announcement** that was just made. The **announcement** came like a bolt from the blue.
english: an act of announcing, or giving notice

paragraph: The students are listening to a history **lecture**. The **lecture** lasted for two hours. You're not to **lecture** me.
english: a spoken lesson
arabicDesc: مثال: الطلاب يستمعون إلى محاضرة في التاريخ.

paragraph: Please attach a **certificate** of quality. I wonder where I can use this gift **certificate**. I'm sorry, Doctor. I lost my health insurance **certificate**.
english: document containing a certified statement

paragraph: The paint on the **trailer** is a bright orange. I thought you used to live in a **trailer**. Have you seen the **trailer** for that new movie?
english: someone who or something that trails (follows behind)

paragraph: This is a **fundamental** question. That's a **fundamental** question that needs to be addressed. In my opinion, happiness has a few **fundamental** requirements.
english: pertaining to the foundation or basis; serving for the foundation

paragraph: Children need to be taught to resist **peer** pressure. I'm studying to become a **peer** support specialist. Don't let **peer** pressure keep you from pursuing your dreams.
english: somebody who is, or something that is, at a level or of a value equal (to that of something else)

paragraph: Have you ever stuck a **poster** on a wall? They noticed a **poster** for a speech competition. I have to design a new **poster** for the movie.
english: a picture of a celebrity, an event etc., intended to be attached to a wall

paragraph: There is a **fence** around the house. They built a **fence** around the farm. He built a **fence** around his house.
english: a thin artificial barrier that separates two pieces of land or forms a perimeter enclosing the lands of a house, building, etc

paragraph: You'll surely have another opportunity to **tackle** this challenge. She swept the ball away with a slide **tackle**. There was a better way to **tackle** that.
english: to force a person to the ground with the weight of one's own body, usually by jumping on top or slamming one's weight into them

paragraph: The **potato** was packaged in red nets. Why does nobody eat my **potatoes**? If I start eating **potato** chips, I can't stop.
english: plant tuber eaten as starchy vegetable
arabicDesc: مثال: كانت البطاطا تحفظوفي شبكات حمراء.

paragraph: I don't care, even were he the **Pope** himself. You can now follow the **Pope** on Twitter. The new **pope** is Catholic and that's not a surprise.
english: an honorary title of the Roman Catholic bishop of Rome as father and head of his church, a sovereign of the Vatican city state

paragraph: I hope I can find a **buyer** for this. They still haven't found a **buyer** for that house. I'll be the first **buyer** of your book.
english: a person who makes one or more purchases

paragraph: The editor and the **publisher** are both my cousins. This **publisher** has put out some very good books. Have you already sent your novel to the **publisher**?
english: a person or (especially) a company who publishes, especially books

paragraph: The people of your country have no mental **discipline**. He is too young to benefit from firm **discipline**. Take a belt and **discipline** your son right now.
english: a controlled behaviour

other.meaning: specific branch or knowledge or learning

paragraph: My **congratulations** on the birth of your baby boy. May I be the first to offer my **congratulations**. So that means you're a student now? **Congratulations**!
english: expressing praise and approval, expressing approbation

paragraph: We're trying to find ourselves something **decent** to eat. They need some **decent** clothes to attend the meetings. No **decent** human being could possibly have done this.
english: good enough; also honest and respectable

paragraph: The word **downtown** refers to the business quarter of any town. I was doing some shopping **downtown**. Which train takes me to **downtown**?
english: the main business part of a city or town, usually located at or near its center
arabicDesc: مثال: إن كلمة مركز المدينة تشير إلى الجزء التجاري من أي مدينة.

paragraph: I started walking back and **forth** in the room. Should we go **forth** with the party on Saturday? March winds and April showers bring **forth** May flowers.
english: forward; back and forth: from side to side

paragraph: What are you trying to do? Drive me **insane**? He is acting a little **insane**. Those who trust themselves to the sea are **insane**!
english: exhibiting unsoundness or disorder of mind
arabicDesc: مثال: ما الذي تحاول فعله؟ أتريدني أن أُجنّ؟

paragraph: Can I stay at your place? I have **nowhere** to go. I was **nowhere** near the park on that night. There is **nowhere** in the whole world without poverty.
english: in no place
arabicDesc: مثال: هل أستطيع البقاء في منزلك؟ ليس لي مكان أذهب إليه.

paragraph: They disputed the **ownership** of the land for years. What does **ownership** mean in the digital age? The cost of car **ownership** is increasing.
english: the state of having complete legal control of something

paragraph: He's a master of light, song-like love **poetry**. My French isn't good enough to understand French **poetry**. Either the man is crazy or he's writing **poetry**.
english: literature composed in verse or language exhibiting conscious attention to patterns and rhythm

paragraph: The husband presents a more **spiritual** vision of religion. Not material, but **spiritual** things determine our life. They gave him both material and **spiritual** support.
english: of or pertaining to the spirit or the soul

paragraph: All of a **sudden**, three dogs appeared in front of us. All of a **sudden**, the door opened and a man entered the room. All of a **sudden**, I remembered that I couldn't pay for so many books.
english: happening quickly and with little or no warning
arabicDesc: مثال: وفجأة ظهرت ثلاث كلاب أمامنا.

paragraph: Where is the **lease**? I want to review it. We have discussed the **lease** on the phone. This new job gave her a new **lease** of life.
english: a contract to rent a property

paragraph: The girl screamed when she saw the **flames**. The food is being cooked over a low **flame**. Just as a **flame** goes out, a man dies.
english: visible part of fire
arabicDesc: مثال: صرخت الفتاة حين رأت ألسنة اللهب.

paragraph: I want to go to the **toilet**. Where can I find the **toilet**? May I use the **toilet**?
english: a room, enclosed area or single-purpose building containing a fixture or fixtures used for urination and defecation

paragraph: She made the decision by herself, without seeking my **counsel**. Give neither **counsel** nor salt until you are asked for. Your honor, I would like to discharge **counsel**.
english: the exchange of opinions and advice especially in legal issues

other.meaning: To give advice, especially professional advice, to (somebody) (verb)

paragraph: It's useless to try and **resist**. She has no strength even to try to **resist**. It made me **resist** the language I was learning.
english: to withstand actions or effects of
arabicDesc: مثال: لن تستفيد من المقاومة فلا تحاول.

paragraph: I must **calculate** how much money I'll spend next week. **Calculate** how much money we will need next year. Performance-based methods are often used to **calculate** bonuses.
english: to determine the value of something or the solution to something by a mathematical process
arabicDesc: مثال: يجب علي حساب كمية المال الذي سوف أنفقه الاسبوع المقبل.

paragraph: **Cookie** is a good name for a small dog. **Cookie** is named after a dog we once had. You can have one more **cookie** if you want.
english: a small, flat, baked good which is either crisp or soft but firm

paragraph: You make me want to **smash** your face in. The player put an easy **smash** into the net. There was a **smash**-up out on Route 66 today.
english: to break (something brittle) violently

other.meaning: to be destroyed by being smashed

paragraph: He couldn't **overcome** the desire for another cigarette. I must pull myself together to **overcome** this incident. They helped her **overcome** her fear of public speaking.
english: to surmount, get the better of
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يستطع التغلب على الرغبة في سيجارةٍ أخرى.

paragraph: Have you ever wanted to have a **fancy** car? I have a **fancy** to live the hard way. Secret society is a **fancy** name for organized crime.
english: the imagination

other.meaning: An image formed in the mind

paragraph: You want to go via the **tunnel**? They dug through the mountain and built a **tunnel**. He was standing at the edge of the **tunnel**.
english: an underground or underwater passage

paragraph: I have never loved you. You **disgust** me. I always look at this picture with **disgust**. My attraction to you has turned to **disgust**.
english: an intense dislike or loathing someone feels for something bad or nasty

paragraph: Should anything **arise**, she will be prepared for it. Joy can only **arise** out of lack of knowledge. What feelings **arise** when I think about my identity?
english: to come up from a lower to a higher position

paragraph: You **bake** in your kitchen. Where did you **bake** them? We are **baking** in the kitchen.
english: to cook in an oven

other.meaning: The act of cooking food by baking (noun)

paragraph: In Islam, we don't **worship** our own desires. Places of **worship** are closed until further notice. He regarded her with **worship** in his eyes.
english: honor and adore, especially as a deity

paragraph: That man may have had a **disability** or something. Have you ever been diagnosed with a learning **disability**? I work to the extent my **disability** allows.
english: a condition that limits what a person can do

paragraph: The **archive** is on the fifth floor. I really hope there is an **archive**. I created an **archive** of my emails.
english: chiefly in the form archives

paragraph: If the students are bored, they will find ways to **entertain** themselves. They put on a show to **entertain** their teachers. Will you **entertain** the guests while I get dressed?
english: to amuse people; to have guests
arabicDesc: مثال: إن ضجر الطلّاب سيجدوا طريقة للترفيه عن نفسهم.

paragraph: You had better take into **consideration** that you are no longer young. The proposal he made yesterday is now under **consideration**. This is something we need to take into **consideration**.
english: careful thought; also kindness to others
arabicDesc: مثال: يجدر بك أن تضع في حسبانك أنك لم تعد شابا.

paragraph: The new team has the **capability** to win. The man has the **capability** to talk. It was because she had faith in his **capabilities**.
english: the ability to do something

paragraph: He did not dare to jump over the **creek**. Do you ever go fishing in that **creek**? I'm out on the island in the **creek**.
english: a small river

paragraph: Farmers **rebelled** against the government. You're a bit of a **rebel**, aren't you? What are the **rebel** groups hoping to achieve?
english: person who resists an established authority

other.meaning: To resist or become defiant toward an authority (verb)

paragraph: They strung the electric wire from **pole** to **pole**. It's not easy to get to the North **Pole**. I wouldn't touch that with a ten foot **pole**.
english: long and slender object for construction or support

paragraph: The **ranger** station called in. You used to be a forest **ranger**, didn't you? The area was turned into a **ranger** station.
english: a person who looks after a forest or park

paragraph: A **bully** used a lighter to burn his hair. Pick on somebody your own size, you **bully**. Do not **bully** someone for their skin color.
english: a noisy, blustering, tyrannical person, more insolent than courageous

paragraph: Progress is monitored daily and stored in a **database**. The number of sentences in this **database** is constantly increasing. I found my email in a public **database**...
english: a set of tables and other objects (queries, reports, forms) in the form of a structured data set

paragraph: She has a very **radical** opinion about the problem. The government watched the activities of **radical** groups carefully. He was singing Welcome Home by **Radical** Face.
english: of or pertaining to the root of a plant

other.meaning: A root (of a number or quantity) (noun)

paragraph: You can **borrow** my car if you want. Can I **borrow** your laptop for a second? I **borrow** books from the library.
english: receive temporarily
arabicDesc: مثال: بإمكانك استعارة سيارتي إن شئت.

paragraph: Who do you want to **exclude** from the will? Why are you trying to **exclude** me from your life? They decided to **exclude** him from their circle.
english: to leave out

paragraph: The food was not fit for man or **beast**. You still got 70 seconds to level this **beast** out! You're a **beast**! You haven't even missed one question!
english: any four-footed land mammal

paragraph: He took a few minutes to **scan** the shop. I'll perform a full **scan** of the system. I want you to **scan** this book.
english: to examine sequentially, carefully, or critically

other.meaning: create an image of something with the use of a scanner

paragraph: He went **abroad** for the purpose of studying English. Do you sometimes go **abroad** on your holidays? We are going to travel **abroad** this summer.
english: in foreign countries
arabicDesc: مثال: سافر خارج البلد ليتعلم الإنجليزية.

paragraph: **Arab** is not a difficult language. All **Arab** countries do not respect any human rights. Is the handsome man an **Arab** or an Indian?
english: of or pertaining to Arabs and their nations

other.meaning: A member of the Semitic ethnic group native to the Arabian Peninsula (noun)

paragraph: All religions are **equally** right, because they're all wrong. They are **equally** matched in their knowledge of English. The company is **equally** owned by the two groups.
english: in an equal manner

paragraph: His daily **fitness** training is very important to him. No one doubts her **fitness** for the post. Many people are moving their **fitness** routines online.
english: the condition of being fit, suitable or appropriate

paragraph: The pain was so **intense** that I couldn't sleep. I struggle to contain the **intense** anger within me. Far from stopping, the storm became much more **intense**.
english: of a characteristic: extreme or very high or strong in degree

paragraph: Do you spend more than $20 per month buying **makeup**? Even when she's not wearing **makeup**, she's very beautiful. Has anybody ever said you wear too much **makeup**?
english: an item's composition

paragraph: Let's **occasionally** change where we go to eat out. She stopped by **occasionally** to fix things for him. They see each other **occasionally** at the coffee shop.
english: on occasion: at relatively infrequent intervals, from time to time, sometimes

paragraph: **Physics** is my favorite subject. My **physics** teacher is different from what he seems. The **physics** teacher was late to class, as usual.
english: branch of science

paragraph: Who stands to gain most from a **potentially** successful deal? Wells and **potentially** dangerous water areas should be fenced off. That could **potentially** become a problem.
english: possibly

paragraph: Don't be **silly**! We're just friends. Good friends. I laughed until I cried. **Silly** little boy.... I need to ask you a **silly** question.
english: foolish, showing a lack of good sense and wisdom
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تكن سخيفا! فنحن أصدقاء جيدون.

paragraph: Knowledge has been passed down to **subsequent** generation. I want quick action **subsequent** to the decision. **Subsequent** constitutional reforms restored relative political stability.
english: coming after something

paragraph: Women should have their faces **visible**. That which is no longer **visible** is easily forgotten. In the snow, the white rabbit was not **visible**.
english: able to be seen
arabicDesc: مثال: ينبغي أن تُظهر النّساء وجوههنّ.

paragraph: Academic **fraud** may be more common than you think. What do you think about the possible voter **fraud**? Fail with honor rather than succeed by **fraud**.
english: the crime of stealing or otherwise illegally obtaining money by use of deception tactics

paragraph: I made them look good at the big **presentation**. I didn't have enough time to finish my **presentation**. It's best to review the material before the **presentation**.
english: the act of presenting, or something presented
